summary: Notes that since ansible-core 2.14, `ansible_failed_task` and `ansible_failed_result` propagate from an inner block to an outer block's rescue when blocks are nested.
questions: With nested blocks, can the outer rescue see which inner task failed?
Do ansible_failed_task variables work across nested blocks?

answer_card.title: Failure variables in nested blocks
answer_card.answer_md: Yes, in `ansible-core` 2.14 or later. Both `ansible_failed_task` and `ansible_failed_result` propagate from an inner block to the `rescue` section of an outer block when blocks are nested.
